source_limitations: Search-engine results occasionally exposed direct PDF URLs and indexed snippets. No direct PDF result was opened or fetched; indexed source-content snippets were not used as factual or structural evidence.
Most annual-report landing pages do not identify whether a PDF is text-native, raster-heavy or structurally mixed. Those candidates remain structure-uncertain.

Terms, licence, privacy and security URLs are recorded only where the official landing metadata or stable government policy page was available; empty values mean pending metadata capture, not adverse findings.
Family relevance for broad court annual reports is not assumed to imply a qualifying aggregate row. Broad reports remain uncertain until allowed metadata establishes a family-justice measure.
This intake does not establish unseen status. The complete exposure ledger and deterministic non-overlap receipt remain authoritative and may exclude any candidate here.
Candidate and source-series identifiers are discovery labels only and require registrar normalization before deterministic selection.

summary.note: Plausible means only that official HTML metadata supports PDF scope, aggregate family-justice relevance and a proposed frozen stratum. It is not an eligibility, rights or selection decision.
